title: Managed Database: maximum resource count
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database maximum resource count is specified by contracted tier. Maximum provisioned resource count in one holding; integer. Maximum accepted capacity amendments per holding in a UTC calendar month; integer.

| Contracted tier | Maximum resource count | Amendment limit |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 64 | 12 |

## Tier comparison
For maximum resource count, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 64.
